entities.summary: Víctor Pujol Sala is a former field hockey midfielder from Spain. He won the silver medal with the men's national team at the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta, Georgia. There he scored the only goal for the Spaniards in the final against the Netherlands (1–3). Victor Pujol was a athletes & competitors from Barcelona (b. 1967-10-04, Barcelona). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
